description: This Java class defines a custom Presentation used in an Android application to demonstrate interaction between primary and secondary screens. It manages the display of display information and allows changing background color dynamically.

classes.name: SamplePresentation
classes.description: A class extending Android's Presentation to showcase display info and change background color.

methods.name: SamplePresentation
methods.description: Constructor initializing the presentation with context and display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the presentation view, sets layout, and displays display name.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the layout and updates display text to show color.
